`metasalmonpy` provides the Python implementation of the
[metasalmon](https://salmon-data-mobilization.github.io/metasalmon/) workflows:
the core package lifecycle, semantic review, ontology term governance,
validation, and Enterprise Data Hub (EDH) metadata behaviour. The version number
is a parity claim naming the metasalmon release whose functionality this package
actually delivers, and [R and Python parity](guides/parity.qmd) is where that
number lives — this page deliberately does not carry a second copy of it, having
read `0.1.6` for the three releases after 0.1.6.

```python
import pandas as pd
from metasalmonpy import create_sdp, validate_salmon_datapackage

observations = pd.DataFrame(
    {
        "species": ["Coho", "Chinook"],
        "catch_count": [100, 200],
    }
)

package_path = create_sdp(
    observations,
    path="catch-sdp",
    dataset_id="catch-monitoring",
    table_id="observations",
    seed_semantics=False,
)

validate_salmon_datapackage(package_path)
```

::: {.callout-important}
Generated metadata is review-ready, not publication-ready. Replace all
`MISSING` values and every `REVIEW:` IRI, then run strict validation with
`require_iris=True`.
:::

## Workflow

```{mermaid}
flowchart LR
    A["pandas DataFrame(s)"] --> B["create_sdp()"]
    B --> C["Review metadata and semantics"]
    C --> D["validate_salmon_datapackage()"]
    D --> E["Rebuild EDH XML"]
    E --> F["Publish complete package"]
```

## Where to start

| Goal | Documentation | Main functions |
|---|---|---|
| Create a package from raw tables | [Get started](getting-started.qmd) | `create_sdp()` |
| Control inference and package assembly | [Package lifecycle](guides/package-lifecycle.qmd) | `infer_salmon_datapackage_artifacts()`, `write_salmon_datapackage()` |
| Decide ontology IRIs and fill in metadata | [Semantic review](guides/semantic-review.qmd) | `review_semantics()`, `accept_suggestion()`, `apply_sdp_semantics()`, `review_metadata()`, `set_sdp_*()` |
| Record missing ontology concepts | [Term requests](guides/term-requests.qmd) | `detect_semantic_term_gaps()`, `render_ontology_term_request()` |
| Validate and export EDH metadata | [EDH and validation](guides/edh-validation.qmd) | `validate_salmon_datapackage()`, `write_edh_xml_from_sdp()` |
| Look up function signatures | [API reference](reference/index.qmd) | All exported functions |

LLM review is strictly opt-in. Supplying context files or context text does not
enable a provider call; `llm_assess=True` is always required.
